source_finding: Compound context tags can still contain wrongly typed child fields. Native 1.6.4 string/integer getters can throw for those children; outer-compound validation alone is insufficient. Identified by source review; no historical failing execution is claimed.
changes: Typed string reads for token, owner, scope and phase; bad phase stays unknown rather than decoding a foreign NBT type.

Matching requires typed owner/dimension and typed optional scope. The six generated cases cover initial malformed-context preservation and bounded diagnostics; exhaustive repeated-corruption evidence history is outside this checkpoint.
Receipt owner/dimension authentication requires typed fields. An unauthenticated malformed compound is operator-only and reports preservation/no-clearance; raw receipt data is not mutated.
Hourly legacy qualification cross-checks raw native JSON counters, per-case results when provided, and actual native completion logs against the summary. Booleans do not count as integer counters.
limitations: No provider-outcome reconciliation, replay, redemption, minting or fence clearing is exposed.
New malformed-field cases are native generated fixtures; stock clients exercise normal and imported-unknown chat, not an exhaustive malformed-command graphical matrix.
Installed providers, dedicated multiplayer, copied worlds, arbitrary pre-save/power-loss atomicity, sustained performance and remaining parity remain open.
